list.title: Approvals
list.description: Review the frozen version's recipients, body, and policy results, then approve.
list.emptyDescription: You cannot approve your own request. Expired, canceled, and version-mismatched items are marked separately.

detail.notFoundDescription: It was canceled or you do not have access to the target.
detail.subject: Subject
detail.htmlSandboxNote: HTML is shown only inside a sandboxed frame.
detail.nativeExportRequiredTitle: Native Campaigns export must be ready
detail.nativeExportNotReady: The native export is {state}. The requester must finish contact sync and prepare the final export before this approval can proceed.
detail.nativeExportUnavailable: No native export is attached yet. The request cannot be approved until Office prepares and syncs it.
detail.nativeExportDescription: Review the exact transformed HTML, field mapping, sender, and recipient count that Zoho Campaigns will receive.
detail.nativeExportNoFieldMap: No variable field mapping is required for this export.
detail.nativeApproveDescription: You checked the frozen Office snapshot and the exact native Campaigns export, including its field mapping. Approval cannot be undone.
detail.nativeApprovePreviewNote: The isolated native HTML and field mapping are shown on the approval page.
detail.snapshotUnavailable: Frozen message content is unavailable, so approval and rejection are hidden until a reviewer with mailbox read access can inspect it.
detail.stateExpired: Expired. A new approval request is needed.
detail.selfApproval: This is your own request. A different active approver must review it.
detail.noDecidePermission: You lack approval permission for this target (mailbox approve grant / role).
detail.versionMismatch: The version changed. Load the latest state.
detail.snapshotMismatch: The current target snapshot differs from the request. A new snapshot review is needed.
detail.approveDescription: You checked the frozen audience, body, and policy results. Approval cannot be undone.
detail.rejectDescription: The reason is kept in the decision record. Edits proceed only as a new revision and request.
detail.revokeDescription: Revokes a grant that has not executed yet. Already-executed items cannot be undone.
detail.executionQueued: Execution was queued. This is not delivery completion.

errors.SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN: You cannot approve your own request. A different approver is required.
errors.APPROVAL_EXPIRED: The approval validity expired. A new approval request is needed.
errors.SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH: Differs from the frozen snapshot. Review the new snapshot.
errors.MAILBOX_APPROVE_DENIED: You do not have approval permission for this mailbox.
errors.MAILBOX_ACCESS_DENIED: You do not have access to the target mailbox.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.VERSION_MISMATCH: The version changed. Load the latest state and try again.
errors.VERSION_PRECONDITION_REQUIRED: Version information is required. Refresh and try again.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: A different request was already received with this key.
errors.REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS: The same request is being processed. Check its status shortly.
errors.WORKSPACE_EMERGENCY_STOP: The workspace is in emergency stop.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
errors.DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE: A dependency is unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.INTERNAL: A server error occurred. Contact support with the request ID.
errors.UNKNOWN: The request could not be processed. Please try again.
